summary: StealthGas Inc., a Greek-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a vessel acquisition agreement to buy four LPG carriers — the 2024-built Eco Enchanted, 2023-built Eco Merlin, 2026-built Eco Nebula and 2025-built Eco Texiana — for an aggregate $254.6 million from entities affiliated with CEO, President, CFO, director and largest stockholder Harry N. Vafias. A transaction committee of independent directors approved the price based on averaged independent valuations. Payment is cash on hand, with an option to defer payment one year interest-free; delivery expected May–September 2027 charter-free, subject to stockholder approval. Fleet grows from 25 to 29 vessels. Watch related-party terms and proxy vote timing.
